findings.description: The Lambda environment variables embed an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. Secrets in configuration and function environment variables can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, Lambda configuration access, or logs, enabling unauthorized AWS access if valid.
The function uses the deprecated nodejs12.x runtime, which is no longer supported and does not receive security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed function.
